mapper.sql: CASE WHEN child.kind = 'activity' THEN 1 END AS child_activity_marker, CASE WHEN child.kind = 'award' THEN 1 END AS child_award_marker, CASE WHEN child.kind = 'gained' THEN 1 END AS child_gained_marker, CASE WHEN child.kind = 'inventory' THEN 1 END AS child_inventory_marker, (child.data->>'id')::uuid AS child_id, (child.data->>'adventure_entry_id')::uuid AS child_adventure_entry_id, (child.data->>'character_id')::uuid AS child_character_id, (child.data->>'adventure_gained_item_id')::uuid AS child_adventure_gained_item_id, child.data->>'description' AS child_description, child.data->>'award_name' AS child_award_name, child.data->>'item_name' AS child_item_name, child.data->>'item_type' AS child_item_type, child.data->>'rarity' AS child_rarity, child.data->>'item_category' AS child_item_category, (child.data->>'requires_attunement')::boolean AS child_requires_attunement, (child.data->>'is_soul_coin')::boolean AS child_is_soul_coin, (child.data->>'quantity')::integer AS child_quantity, child.data->>'acquisition_source' AS child_acquisition_source, (child.data->>'needs_details')::boolean AS child_needs_details, child.data->>'source' AS child_source, child.data->>'notes' AS child_notes, (child.data->>'created_at')::timestamp AS child_created_at, (child.data->>'updated_at')::timestamp AS child_updated_at

SELECT 'activity' AS kind, to_jsonb(d) AS data FROM downtime_activity d WHERE d.adventure_entry_id = ae.id UNION ALL SELECT 'award', to_jsonb(s) FROM adventure_story_award s WHERE s.adventure_entry_id = ae.id
mapper.select: SELECT ae.*, c.id AS owner_character_id, FROM "character" c LEFT JOIN adventure_entry ae ON ae.character_id = c.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL () child ON TRUE WHERE c.id = #{characterId}::uuid AND c.user_id = #{userId}::uuid ORDER BY ae.play_date ASC NULLS LAST, ae.created_at ASC, ae.id ASC, (child.data->>'created_at')::timestamp ASC, child.data->>'id' ASC

SELECT ae.*, c.id AS owner_character_id, following.id AS next_id, following.starting_classes_string AS next_starting_classes_string, following.starting_gold AS next_starting_gold, following.starting_downtime AS next_starting_downtime, following.starting_magic_items AS next_starting_magic_items,
FROM adventure_entry ae INNER JOIN "character" c ON c.id = ae.character_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT n.id, n.starting_classes_string, n.starting_gold, n.starting_downtime, n.starting_magic_items FROM adventure_entry n WHERE n.character_id = ae.character_id AND n.id != ae.id AND n.play_date IS NOT NULL AND (n.play_date > ae.play_date OR (n.play_date = ae.play_date AND (n.created_at, n.id) > (ae.created_at, ae.id))) ORDER BY n.play_date ASC, n.created_at ASC, n.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) following ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
UNION ALL SELECT 'gained', to_jsonb(g) FROM adventure_gained_item g WHERE g.adventure_entry_id = ae.id UNION ALL SELECT 'inventory', to_jsonb(i) FROM inventory_item i WHERE i.character_id = ae.character_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM adventure_gained_item g WHERE g.adventure_entry_id = ae.id) ) child ON TRUE WHERE ae.id = #{id}::uuid AND c.user_id = #{userId}::uuid ORDER BY (child.data->>'created_at')::timestamp ASC, child.data->>'id' ASC

SELECT c.updated_at AS character_updated_at, c.current_classes_string AS starting_classes_string, COALESCE(c.current_gold, 0) AS starting_gold, COALESCE(c.current_downtime, 0) AS starting_downtime, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.quantity) FROM inventory_item i WHERE i.character_id = c.id AND i.item_type = 'PERMANENT'::item_type), 0) AS starting_magic_items FROM "character" c WHERE c.id = #{characterId}::uuid AND c.user_id = #{userId}::uuid
SELECT * FROM adventure_entry WHERE character_id = #{characterId}::uuid ORDER BY play_date ASC NULLS LAST, created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT ae.* FROM adventure_entry ae INNER JOIN "character" c ON c.id = ae.character_id WHERE ae.id = #{id}::uuid AND c.user_id = #{userId}::uuid
SELECT * FROM adventure_entry WHERE character_id = #{characterId}::uuid ORDER BY play_date DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM adventure_entry WHERE character_id = #{characterId}::uuid)
SELECT * FROM adventure_entry WHERE character_id = #{characterId}::uuid AND play_date IS NOT NULL AND play_date <= #{playDate} ORDER BY play_date DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adventure_entry ( id, character_id, adventure_code, adventure_name, play_date, dm_name, starting_level, ending_level, starting_gold, gold_change, gold_downtime_change, gold_total, starting_downtime, downtime_change, downtime_downtime_change, downtime_total, starting_magic_items, magic_items_change, magic_items_downtime_change, magic_items_total, magic_items_lost, magic_items_downtime_lost, starting_classes_string, ending_classes_string, level_up_class_name, catchup_class_name, catchup_count, adventure_notes, soul_coin_charges_used, recording_model_version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{characterId}::uuid, #{adventureCode}, #{adventureName}, #{playDate}, #{dmName}, #{startingLevel}, #{endingLevel}, #{startingGold}, #{goldChange}, #{goldDowntimeChange}, #{goldTotal}, #{startingDowntime}, #{downtimeChange}, #{downtimeDowntimeChange}, #{downtimeTotal}, #{startingMagicItems}, #{magicItemsChange}, #{magicItemsDowntimeChange}, #{magicItemsTotal}, COALESCE(#{magicItemsLost}, 0), COALESCE(#{magicItemsDowntimeLost}, 0), #{startingClassesString}, #{endingClassesString}, #{levelUpClassName}, #{catchupClassName}, #{catchupCount}, #{adventureNotes}, #{soulCoinChargesUsed}, COALESCE(#{recordingModelVersion}, 1), NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE adventure_entry SET adventure_code = #{adventureCode}, adventure_name = #{adventureName}, play_date = #{playDate}, dm_name = #{dmName}, starting_level = #{startingLevel}, ending_level = #{endingLevel}, starting_gold = #{startingGold}, gold_change = #{goldChange}, gold_downtime_change = #{goldDowntimeChange}, gold_total = #{goldTotal}, starting_downtime = #{startingDowntime}, downtime_change = #{downtimeChange}, downtime_downtime_change = #{downtimeDowntimeChange}, downtime_total = #{downtimeTotal}, starting_magic_items = #{startingMagicItems}, magic_items_change = #{magicItemsChange}, magic_items_downtime_change = #{magicItemsDowntimeChange}, magic_items_total = #{magicItemsTotal}, magic_items_lost = COALESCE(#{magicItemsLost}, 0), magic_items_downtime_lost = COALESCE(#{magicItemsDowntimeLost}, 0), starting_classes_string = #{startingClassesString}, ending_classes_string = #{endingClassesString}, level_up_class_name = #{levelUpClassName}, catchup_class_name = #{catchupClassName}, catchup_count = #{catchupCount}, adventure_notes = #{adventureNotes}, soul_coin_charges_used = #{soulCoinChargesUsed}, recording_model_version = COALESCE(#{recordingModelVersion}, recording_model_version), updated_at = GREATEST(clock_timestamp()::timestamp, updated_at + INTERVAL '1 microsecond') WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
